title: Kelmarsh road repair weekly status
brief: Hello, I coordinate the road repair program for Kelmarsh Council, and I need a weekly status page for the week ending 2026-10-30 that councillors will read on their phones. Lead with the headline numbers: 612 potholes repaired this week, a backlog of 1480, an average repair time of 6.4 days against a target of 5, and 88 percent of jobs finished on time. Under "Backlog trend" chart the open backlog over eight weeks: W37 1910, W38 1840, W39 1795, W40 1710, W41 1650, W42 1590, W43 1535, W44 1480. Under "Districts" give a table of backlog, repaired this week and average days to repair: Northgate 310, 142, 5.1; Central 402, 171, 6.0; Eastfield 285, 118, 5.8; Riverside 366, 84, 9.7; Harbor 117, 97, 4.2. Under "Needs attention": Riverside is the one to flag clearly, because the flood closure of Mill Bridge on 2026-10-21 kept crews out for four days. Under "Next week": night resurfacing on Mill Road starting 2026-11-03, a second crew moved to Riverside on 2026-11-02, and the budget review with the finance committee on 2026-11-05.

edit.request: Add W45 at 1425 to the trend, change the headline backlog to 1425, and change Riverside's average days to repair from 9.7 to 8.9.
